record.title: Basic Rules for the Power Ancillary Services Market
record.issuer: National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC); National Energy Administration (NEA)
record.relation_note: The ancillary-services definition covers peak shaving, frequency regulation, reserves and ramping; principle: 'whoever provides, profits; whoever benefits, bears'; market participants include new types of participant such as storage enterprises and virtual power plants
record.note: NDRC original text (also available in a government-information-disclosure PDF edition); the document sets no separate effective date, so effective_date is left blank.
